rotari: lightweight local job queue

Coding agents: run `rotari guide` first for the recommended workflow and a command reference.

Usage:
  rotari config [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--list] [--notifications] [-o FORMAT|--format FORMAT] [--output FILE]
  rotari check [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--json] [--deep] [--quiet] [PROJECT]
  rotari reset [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--recover] [--quiet] [PROJECT]
  rotari cancel [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--wait] [--yes] [--filter-state STATE] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [JOB_ID|ATTEMPT_ID|RUN_ID ...]
  rotari suspend [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--yes] [--filter-state STATE] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [JOB_ID|ATTEMPT_ID|RUN_ID ...]
  rotari resume [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--yes] [--filter-state STATE] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [JOB_ID|ATTEMPT_ID|RUN_ID ...]
  rotari delete [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [--all] [--dry-run] [--if-revision REVISION] [RUN_ID]
  rotari gc [--config FILE] [--masterdir DIR] [--apply] [MASTERDIR]
  rotari unlock [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [PROJECT]
  rotari change [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--all] [-e EXECUTOR|--executor EXECUTOR] [--executor-option OPTION] [--clear-executor-options] [--working-directory DIR] [--clear-working-directory] [--env KEY=VALUE] [--clear-env] [--set-job-name NAME] [--depends-on NAME] [--clear-depends-on] [--depends-on-finished NAME] [--clear-depends-on-finished] [--timeout DURATION] [--clear-timeout] [--retry N] [--clear-retry] [--retry-delay DURATION] [--retry-backoff FACTOR] [--retry-max-delay DURATION] [--status STATUS] [--clear-status] [--quiet] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [--dry-run] [--if-revision REVISION] <command ...>
  rotari export [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [-o FORMAT|--format FORMAT] [--template] [--output FILE] [TARGET] [FILE]
  rotari import [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--overwrite] [--json] [--dry-run] [--if-revision REVISION] FILE [PROJECT]
  rotari remove [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--all] [--quiet] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [--dry-run] [--if-revision REVISION] [JOB_ID ...]
  rotari show [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--masterdir DIR] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [--queue] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--failed] [--unfinished] [--success] [--stage NAME] [--matrix NAME] [--logs] [--failed-logs] [--stream STREAM] [--follow] [--no-pager] [--basedirs] [--json] [--report] [--filter-result RESULT] [--filter-exit-code N] [--filter-failure-kind KIND] [--filter-diagnosis VALUE] [--filter-changed] [--filter-new] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-finished-after TIME] [--filter-finished-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [SELECTOR]
  rotari lineage [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--json] [RUN_ID ...]
  rotari jobs [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [--masterdir DIR] [--all-basedirs] [-o FORMAT|--format FORMAT] [--since DURATION] [PROJECT]
  rotari diagnose [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--rules] [--provider PROVIDER] [--endpoint URL] [--model MODEL] [--language TAG] [JOB_ID]
  rotari wait [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [--timeout DURATION] [--until-failure] [--json] [PROJECT_OR_RUN_NAME_OR_RUN_ID ...]
  rotari add [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-e EXECUTOR|--executor EXECUTOR] [--executor-option OPTION] [--output FILE] [--error FILE] [--log-mode MODE] [--open-mode MODE] [--working-directory DIR] [--env KEY=VALUE] [--job-name NAME] [--stage NAME] [--depends-on NAME] [--depends-on-finished NAME] [--timeout DURATION] [--retry N] [--retry-delay DURATION] [--retry-backoff FACTOR] [--retry-max-delay DURATION] [--array FIRST-LAST|TASK[,TASK...]] [--matrix KEY=VALUE[,VALUE...]] [--quiet] [--dry-run] [--if-revision REVISION] <command ...>
  rotari copy [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [--failed] [--unfinished] [--success] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--append] [--overwrite] [--quiet] [--filter-result RESULT] [--filter-exit-code N] [--filter-failure-kind KIND] [--filter-diagnosis VALUE] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-finished-after TIME] [--filter-finished-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [--dry-run] [--if-revision REVISION] [RUN_ID]
  rotari run [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [--overwrite] [--run-name NAME] [--local-concurrency N] [--batch-concurrency N] [--retry N] [--failed] [--unfinished] [--success] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--job-name NAME] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--partial-array] [--async] [--quiet] [-e EXECUTOR|--executor EXECUTOR] [--env ALL|NONE] [--match-by MODE] [--executor-option OPTION] [--ssh-concurrency N] [--ssh-options OPTION] [--slurm-concurrency N] [--slurm-options OPTION] [--slurm-submit-interval DURATION] [--slurm-submit-retry-limit N] [--pbs-concurrency N] [--pbs-options OPTION] [--pbs-submit-interval DURATION] [--pbs-submit-retry-limit N] [--lsf-concurrency N] [--lsf-options OPTION] [--lsf-submit-interval DURATION] [--lsf-submit-retry-limit N] [--sge-concurrency N] [--sge-options OPTION] [--sge-submit-interval DURATION] [--sge-submit-retry-limit N] [--filter-result RESULT] [--filter-exit-code N] [--filter-failure-kind KIND] [--filter-diagnosis VALUE] [--filter-changed] [--filter-new] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-finished-after TIME] [--filter-finished-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [RUN_ID]
  rotari retry [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [-p NAME|--project-name NAME] [-r ID|--run-id ID] [--overwrite] [--run-name NAME] [--local-concurrency N] [--batch-concurrency N] [--retry N] [-j ID|--job-id ID] [--stage STAGE] [--matrix NAME] [--async] [--quiet] [-e EXECUTOR|--executor EXECUTOR] [--env ALL|NONE] [--executor-option OPTION] [--ssh-concurrency N] [--ssh-options OPTION] [--slurm-concurrency N] [--slurm-options OPTION] [--slurm-submit-interval DURATION] [--slurm-submit-retry-limit N] [--pbs-concurrency N] [--pbs-options OPTION] [--pbs-submit-interval DURATION] [--pbs-submit-retry-limit N] [--lsf-concurrency N] [--lsf-options OPTION] [--lsf-submit-interval DURATION] [--lsf-submit-retry-limit N] [--sge-concurrency N] [--sge-options OPTION] [--sge-submit-interval DURATION] [--sge-submit-retry-limit N] [--filter-result RESULT] [--filter-exit-code N] [--filter-failure-kind KIND] [--filter-diagnosis VALUE] [--filter-changed] [--filter-new] [--filter-host PATTERN] [--filter-started-after TIME] [--filter-started-before TIME] [--filter-finished-after TIME] [--filter-finished-before TIME] [--filter-longer-than DURATION] [--filter-shorter-than DURATION] [--filter-command RE] [--filter-stage NAME] [--filter-not-stage NAME] [--filter-matrix NAME] [--filter-not-matrix NAME] [RUN_ID]
  rotari server <status|list|shutdown> [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [--masterdir DIR]
  rotari web [--config FILE] [-b DIR|--basedir DIR] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--static-dir DIR] [--allow-control] [--auth-token TOKEN] [--notifications]
  rotari completion <bash|zsh|fish|install>
  rotari schema [--json]
  rotari guide
  rotari version
  rotari env
